variation: sample standard deviation over seeds 0, 1, 2 (initialisation and data order); not a confidence interval

reference.paper: Fonseca et al., FSD50K: An Open Dataset of Human-Labeled Sound Events, IEEE/ACM TASLP 30 (2022) (arXiv:2010.00475), Table VI, VGG-like
reference.code: none online (the baseline repository linked from the paper has been removed)

protocol.data: FSD50K builder, config '22khz'; train 36,796 / validation 4,170 / test (eval) 10,231 clips, 200 classes, smeared labels as released
protocol.front_end: log10 mel, 96 bands, 30 ms window, hop 220 (10 ms); 1 s patches (101 frames), clips under 1 s replicated, longer clips sliced with 50% overlap; patches inherit the clip labels; standardised with train-split mean/std
protocol.model: VGG-like: 3x conv32, maxpool 2, 2x conv64, maxpool 2, conv128 (3x3, BN, ReLU); concat global max + average pooling; FC 256 ReLU; FC 200 sigmoid; 265,992 weights; Glorot-uniform init, Keras BN (eps 1e-3, momentum 0.01)
protocol.training: binary cross-entropy, Adam lr 3e-4 (eps 1e-7), batch 64, shuffled; lr halved after 5 epochs without a better validation mAP, early stop after 10, at most 100 epochs
protocol.selection: checkpoint with the best validation mAP (the paper used TensorFlow's PR-AUC); test evaluated once with it
protocol.metrics: clip score = mean of patch sigmoid outputs; mAP and d' = sqrt(2) * Phi^-1(ROC-AUC) per class, averaged over classes; lwlrap_class = per-class label-ranking precision averaged over classes (the paper's reporting, Sec. V-A); lwlrap = DCASE 2019 definition, every (clip, label) pair weighted equally

environment.metrics_note: test metrics recomputed from the saved predictions.npz after lwlrap_class was added; mAP, d' and lwlrap match the training-time values exactly
environment.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti (Brown CS Hydra cluster), fp32
